fields.text: Loop with sound. FLUX.3 Klein paints a rainy shop window. Pixelcut Looping Video (motion: subtle) brings it to life in a 5 s clip that starts and ends on the same picture. ElevenLabs Sound Effects V3 with its Seamless loop switch ON makes 5 s of rain ambience that also wraps with no click. Soundtrack (loop on) joins them: picture AND sound loop forever, for an ambient screen, a shop-page hero or a background tab. Change the scene + sound text and ▶ Run.

Cozy little bookshop window at night seen from inside, rain streaking down the glass, blurred warm street lights outside, on the wooden windowsill a stack of old books, a brass reading lamp glowing amber and a white teacup with a thin wisp of steam. Cinematic, warm and cool contrast, photoreal, still camera, no people, no text, no logos.

fields.prompt: Raindrops trickle down the window glass, the steam from the teacup curls gently, the street lights outside shimmer softly. Camera locked, lighting steady.

fields.text: Steady gentle rain pattering on a window pane, soft drips, a calm cozy indoor room tone, no thunder, no music, no voices.
